title: Field session manifest, version 1
description: The session.json at the top of a field session folder: one continuous recording session with its notes, photos, video clips and handwriting, each placed in time and on the audio.

format.description: Always this text. It says what kind of file this is.

title.description: The session's title, as the researcher typed it.

utcOffset.description: The device's offset from UTC when the session was created.

timeZone.description: The device's time zone when the session was created, for example Europe/Lisbon.

participants.description: Pseudonymous participant codes, for example P-014. Never names.

researcher.description: The researcher's display name, if one was set on the device.

device.description: What made the session. Never the device's own name.

model.description: The hardware model, for example iPhone18,1.

os.description: The operating system and its version.

startLocation.description: Where the device was when the session started. Present only if location was on.

spans.description: Every unbroken stretch of recorded audio, in order. Pausing, an interruption or a crash ends one span.

items.description: Everything on the page, in the order it was made.

instant.description: A moment in UTC with milliseconds, for example 2026-11-23T10:42:10.120Z.

utcOffset.description: An offset from UTC, for example +01:00. With it, local clock time can be shown again.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of a file, as 64 lower-case hex characters.

relativePath.description: A path inside the session folder, with forward slashes, no hidden parts and no leading slash.

accuracyM.description: How accurate the position is, in metres.

id.description: The span's own id. Items point to it with spanId.

sha256.description: The audio file's hash. Filled in when the session is finished.

startedAt.description: When this stretch of recording began.

utcOffset.description: The device's offset from UTC when it began.

timeZone.description: The device's time zone when it began.

durationMs.description: How long the stretch is. Absent while it is still being recorded.

endedBy.description: Why the stretch ended. Absent while it is still being recorded.

item.description: One thing on the page. Its kind decides which of the five shapes below it must have.

marker.description: A note the app makes itself about recording or location.

kind.description: What kind of item this is.

utcOffset.description: The device's offset from UTC at that instant.

spanId.description: The recording span it falls on. Absent when nothing was recording.

offsetMs.description: How far into that span's audio it falls, measured on the audio's own clock.

kind.description: What kind of item this is.

at.description: When its first character was typed.

utcOffset.description: The device's offset from UTC at that instant.

spanId.description: The recording span it falls on. Absent when nothing was recording.

offsetMs.description: How far into that span's audio it falls, measured on the audio's own clock.

modifiedAt.description: When the note was last changed, if it was changed after it was first typed.

kind.description: What kind of item this is.

utcOffset.description: The device's offset from UTC at that instant.

spanId.description: The recording span it falls on. Absent when nothing was recording.

offsetMs.description: How far into that span's audio it falls, measured on the audio's own clock.

sha256.description: The photo file's hash. Filled in when the session is finished.

gps.description: Where it was taken. Present only if location was on.

kind.description: What kind of item this is.

utcOffset.description: The device's offset from UTC at that instant.

spanId.description: The recording span its start falls on. Absent when nothing was recording.

offsetMs.description: How far into that span's audio the clip starts, measured on the audio's own clock.

durationMs.description: How long the clip is. Absent if it was cut off and its length is unknown.

endedBy.description: Why the clip ended. Absent while it is still being recorded.

sound.description: False for a clip made while recording was paused, which is silent.

sha256.description: The clip file's hash. Filled in when the session is finished.

gps.description: Where it was shot. Present only if location was on.

kind.description: What kind of item this is.

utcOffset.description: The device's offset from UTC at that instant.

spanId.description: The recording span its start falls on. Absent when nothing was recording.

offsetMs.description: How far into that span's audio it starts, measured on the audio's own clock.

sha256.description: The picture's hash. Filled in when the session is finished.

data.description: The ink as drawing data, so it can be opened and edited again.

dataSha256.description: The drawing data's hash. Filled in when the session is finished.

strokes.description: Every stroke with its own time, so handwriting can be placed on the audio stroke by stroke.

offsetMs.description: How far into the item's span the stroke began.

bounds.description: The stroke's box on the page: x, y, width, height.
